::: {#sol-transformer-lm}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
train_lm(transformer, 1500, lr=0.005)
train_lm(gru_lm, 1500, lr=0.005)
transformer_ppl = val_perplexity(transformer)
gru_ppl = val_perplexity(gru_lm)
print(transformer_ppl, gru_ppl)
# The prose below says the Transformer wins; stop the render if not.
assert transformer_ppl < gru_ppl
```

The Transformer.
Its validation [perplexity](language-models.qmd#def-perplexity) is `r sprintf("%.2f", py$transformer_ppl)`,
against `r sprintf("%.2f", py$gru_ppl)` for the [GRU](rnns.qmd#def-gru),
after the same number of steps on the same windows.
The Transformer also has about
`r sprintf("%.1f", py$n_params(py$transformer) / py$n_params(py$gru_lm))`
times as many [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter),
so this comparison does not separate the architecture from the size.

:::
